name: Night Sky Quiz
description: Eleven friendly questions about the Moon, planets and stars.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Eleven multiple-choice questions about the Moon, planets and stars, shown on Quick Quiz.
help.goal: Just for fun. Answer a few or all eleven; your score is shown only to you.
howToPlay: Read the question and choose an answer.
You will see the right answer and a short explanation.
Press Next question to carry on, or stop whenever you like.
At the end, Play again gives a fresh shuffle.
tips: The order of questions and answers changes each time you play.
